description: Every filter in the workbook, deduplicated across worksheets: the field it acts on (caption-resolved), filter kind (categorical / quantitative / relative-date), whether it is a context filter, which worksheets use it, selected member values when stored, and quantitative ranges. Includes a by_worksheet grouping and the distinct list of fields driving any filter. Data-source filters are marked "(data source filter)".

path.description: Absolute (or cwd-relative) path to a local Tableau workbook: .twbx or .twb

name: list_filters
title: List the filters in the workbook
